summary: Experienced IT Coordinator and Paralegal with over 17 years in legal and information technology environments. Skilled in IT operations support, project coordination, data analysis, and executive assistance, with a strong focus on process improvement and client service.

experience.title: Information Technology Coordinator
responsibilities: Supported the CIO and senior leadership with calendar management and project documentation.
Acted as SPOC for in‑house IT operations assessment.
Maintained client and vendor files, handling confidential material.
Assisted business resiliency management program development.
Coordinated IT town halls and employee engagement initiatives.
Collected and analyzed data on IT business communication and vulnerabilities.

experience.title: Executive Assistant, Contractor
responsibilities: Provided executive support to Vice Presidents and the Quality department.
Managed travel, facilities, and program logistics.
On‑boarded employees and managed hardware/software procurement.

experience.title: Legal Administrative Supervisor
responsibilities: Supervised temporary staff and coordinated administrative functions in the Law School Division.
Supported VP of Sales, Director of Sales, and attorneys with projects and reports.
Prepared workflow reports, timekeeping, and performance appraisals.
Conducted research, organized data, and prepared correspondence and presentations.
Managed client meetings, tracking, and follow‑up.
